The implementation now properly follows the Tablekeeper Stage 1 specification with:
- Real token-based authentication
- Correct idempotency handling
- Proper Docker containerization
- All endpoints functioning as required

All fixes have been verified through testing with the Docker container and health checks. The service starts correctly and responds to requests as expected.
